cleaning_notes: Source: one Word table, 161 data rows; decimal commas read as decimal points.
Status -> group (Infected -> infected, Control -> control). Outcome (Survived/Died) -> outcomes file 'died'; controls have Outcome 'Control' and died = null.
Original case numbers are kept only in the outcomes file (original_id); dog_id is neutral.
Gender holds only Male or Female: sex is recorded, neuter status is not in the file (no neuter variable).

values.cohort: 1 for cases 1-97 and controls 201-215 (Oct 2011 - Apr 2013, cytokines measured); 2 for cases 101-144 and controls 216-220 (2014, no cytokine columns). Cohort is confounded with assay availability and year.

Cohort 1 has 97 infected dogs in the file; the article reports 96. The article reports 140 infected in total; the file has 141. dog S-CB050:d037 has no MPXI, which may explain the published n of 140/96 for MPXI analyses (inferred, not stated).

Cytokine floors (record; the article sets values below the detection limit to the minimum detectable concentration): IL-2 3.4, IL-6 3.6, IL-10 8.4, IL-18 5.7, GM-CSF 9.1. Values equal to the floor are flagged censored = floor. Counts at floor: il2 30, il6 11, il10 5, il18 4, gmcsf 28.

Ceiling: dog S-CB050:d125 has 50001.0 in IL-2, IL-6, IL-18 and GM-CSF, read as an above-range code; kept as 50001.0 and flagged censored = ceiling (dog S-CB050:d125 gmcsf; dog S-CB050:d125 il18; dog S-CB050:d125 il2; dog S-CB050:d125 il6). S-CB517 gives the same cells as 50000.0.
IL-8 and MCP-1 have no documented floor; IL-8 has its minimum 21.6 in 3 dogs, which may be an undocumented floor (not flagged).
Missing (null): age in dog S-CB050:d070; weight in 10 dogs; MPXI in dog S-CB050:d037; all 7 cytokines in cohort 2 (49 dogs).
Blood was taken at presentation before treatment (article full text). Infected: timepoint admission; controls: single.
Never pool with S-CB517 (same dogs: cases 1-97 and controls 201-215) or with DS04 (at least 3 shared dogs, data.md).
Died includes euthanasia for poor prognosis (article full text); the label is only in the outcomes file.
No value was changed. Floating-point noise was rounded to 10 decimals.
